name: CoorNut
formula: =LAMBDA(width,thickness,[isRepeatFirstPoint],LET(chamfer_width, width / 8, chamfer_height, chamfer_width * TAN(RADIANS(30)), x_1, width / 2, x_2, width / 2 - chamfer_width, y_1, thickness / 2, y_2, thickness / 2 - chamfer_height, pt_1, HSTACK(-x_2, y_1), pt_2, HSTACK(-x_1, y_2), pt_3, HSTACK(-x_1, -y_2), pt_4, HSTACK(-x_2, -y_1), pt_5, HSTACK(x_2, -y_1), pt_6, HSTACK(x_1, -y_2), pt_7, HSTACK(x_1, y_2), pt_8, HSTACK(x_2, y_1), arr, VSTACK(pt_1, pt_2, pt_3, pt_4, pt_5, pt_6, pt_7, pt_8), IF(isRepeatFirstPoint, VSTACK(arr, pt_1), arr)))
comment: Create Coordinates of nuts. Last update at 2024-11-19.
